svg.title: Helix — voice flow data pipeline
svg.desc: Data-flow detail of the Helix voice subsystem: browser mic push-to-talk captured as WAV, proxied through the auth-gated /api/voice/transcribe endpoint to voice-box STT, with the transcript landing in the chat input; and the reverse path where the Speak button sends reply text through /api/voice/speak to voice-box TTS for WAV playback.
svg.text: left chip = input · right chip = output
